preToolUse.command: command -v specforge >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'specforge is not on PATH: the hook t.write_guard cannot run, so it denies' >&2; exit 2; }; specforge hook t.write_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools write # specforge-install

command -v specforge >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'specforge is not on PATH: the hook t.validate_commit cannot run, so it denies' >&2; exit 2; }; specforge hook t.validate_commit --host cursor --event pre_commit # specforge-install

command -v specforge >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'specforge is not on PATH: the hook core.spec_guard cannot run, so it denies' >&2; exit 2; }; specforge hook core.spec_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools write,edit --paths '**/*.spec' # specforge-install

postToolUse.command: specforge hook t.injection_scan --host cursor --event post_tool --tools read # specforge-install
specforge hook t.context_monitor --host cursor --event post_tool # specforge-install
specforge hook t.record_hook --host cursor --event post_tool --tools write --paths '**' # specforge-install

sessionStart.command: specforge hook t.session_cursor --host cursor --event session_start # specforge-install
